name: After recital D
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming European Research Area (ERA) Act
part_text: 9a. Calls on the Commission to take effective action to address the high geographical concentration of Horizon Europe funds by strengthening the instruments aimed at the participation of countries in the Widening programme and ensuring a more balanced distribution of resources that takes into account the existing asymmetries in scientific and technological development, promoting economic, social and territorial cohesion by building research and innovation capacities in the less developed Member States;
